Production Notes

THREE ACTS.
One legend.

01Act I

Upload the Star

Send us your best photo — clear, expressive, full of personality. The more dramatic their expression, the better. Natural ham-ness strongly encouraged.

02Act II

Pick the Genre

Action hero? Fantasy villain? Romantic lead? Sci-fi commander? Choose a style — or let us write the role your pet was clearly born to play.

03Act III

Receive the Legend

Your poster arrives digitally, print-ready and share-ready. Post it. Frame it. Send it to everyone you know. Watch them cry-laugh.

Audience

THIS IS FOR
all of you.

01

The Gift People

When you've run out of ideas for the person whose pet IS their personality. A cinematic portrait of their dog is the gift they didn't know existed and will never stop showing everyone.

02

The Memorial Crowd

For the ones you've lost. Not a sad photo on the mantle — a full tribute to the legend they were. Funny, dramatic, worthy of the chaos they caused in your life.

03

The Birthday Girlies

Gotcha days. Pet birthdays. Anniversaries of the day they showed up and ruined your couch. Any occasion is right when your pet deserves recognition.

04

The Creators

Running a pet account? This is your next viral post. A cinematic portrait of your pet as a movie star markets itself for the next three weeks. You're welcome.

05

The Social Obsessives

Every Pawlywood poster is built for sharing. Formatted for TikTok and Instagram. Designed to stop the scroll. Engineered to be forwarded at 2am to your group chat.

06

The Unhinged Pet Parents

If your camera roll is 94% your pet and you've already given them a full name and a character arc — this is the natural next step. You know who you are.
